rationale: JD's conviction about cutting through hype in India's Web3 scene and shipping real products aligns well with Sharon's focus on production-ready AI agent infrastructure—both are oriented toward substance over flashiness. While JD brings smart contract and developer tooling expertise from the Solana ecosystem, Sharon's work scaling agentic AI across biotech, healthtech, and fintech represents a different technical frontier; they can exchange perspectives on what it takes to build credible, deployable tech rather than demo-day theater.
intro_message: JD, meet Sharon—she's building production-grade AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai and would probably appreciate your no-nonsense take on real builders vs. hype.
